question.text: For 'Yamuna Infra AIF', invested capital after three drawdowns is INR 650 crore against a committed capital of INR 1,000 crore. What is the DRY POWDER / pending drawdowns at the fund level?

explanation.text: The Logic: Dry powder (pending drawdowns) = Committed - Invested = INR 1000 cr - INR 650 cr = INR 350 crore. This is the fund-level uncalled capital illustrated in Chapter 7 section on drawdowns. The Trap: Option B is invested capital. Option C is committed. Option D is additive error.
